references.detail: 483 Eighth Air Force escorts; 12 claimed destroyed in the air. One probable, three damaged and two ground claims are separate.
Original Eighth Air Force mission report, archival catalogue entry.
German calendar reports 10 own aircraft lost in its wider area. The daily summary covers day and night activity and leaves the cause and Allied attribution of those losses open.
The encounter report illustrates the wider air-combat geography of the day.

training.detail: Evening encounter. The Clark-based reconstruction matches 14 US claims to nine Bf 109 losses. Jure’s report corroborates 56th Fighter Group participation. The Eighth Air Force day summary covers additional missions.

references.page: Challenging the numerical superiority, citing Clark p. 94 and 27 June daily tables

training.detail: Eleven distinct claims from the squadron breakdown. The shared Bf 109 is counted once. Blake identifies at least seven German losses. The baseline excludes Wimsche’s forced landing because its final aircraft disposition is unclear.

references.page: 18 July morning engagement, squadron reports and German loss reconstruction

check.detail: The account reports two German pilots lost in the Fw 190 fight. The reconstruction counts their aircraft and excludes Stein’s damaged Fw 190, which was repaired. Dreux was a separate fight.

references.page: Ch. 11, Rambouillet and 16 August repair account

germanClaims.detail: Noon engagement. The reconstruction identifies two US P-47s and three RAF Typhoons lost.

references.page: 6 June noon engagement, citing Clark p. 42

germanClaims.detail: Caldwell compares four German credits with two US P-38s lost in that engagement.

references.page: Ch. 11, Wiegand’s 11 June combat and cross-check

germanClaims.detail: Two US P-38s were seen being shot down. A third, flown by Glenn Goodrich, was lost in the engagement after its engine caught fire. Blake counts three combat losses. The engine fire’s cause is less certain in the witness account.

references.page: 18 July, the three US loss accounts and German claims

germanClaims.detail: Caldwell matches the eight German claims to three P-47s shot down in the Rambouillet fight.
